**Chinese name:** 兆易创新科技集团股份有限公司 (Zhàoyì Chuàngxīn Kējì Jítuán Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2005; one of the largest NOR flash and MCU suppliers globally, representing the mass-market, lower-complexity end of China's fabless sector rather than the leading-edge/AI segment most export-control coverage focuses on. A 2026 global memory supply crunch (AI-driven DRAM/NAND demand tightening prices across the board) lifted GigaDevice's pricing power sharply: H1 2026 revenue of ¥11.57 billion (+178.7% YoY) and net profit of ¥6.86 billion (+1,091.5% YoY), per the interim report of 18 August 2026, part of it from fair-value gains on securities including its CXMT (长鑫科技) stake. Q1 2026 alone showed revenue +119.4% and net profit +522.8% year-on-year.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NOR flash memory chips, general-purpose microcontrollers, and sensors for consumer electronics, industrial, and automotive applications.
